title: Independent vs Dependent Variables
description: An interactive scatter plot MicroSim that lets students experiment with changing an independent variable (study time) and observe how the dependent variable (test score) responds.
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the independent variable (hours studied, controlled) and the dependent variable (test score, measured) in a study-time scenario
Explain why the independent variable is plotted on the x-axis and the dependent variable on the y-axis of a scatter plot
Predict a student's approximate test score from study hours using the trend line and hover prediction feature
Observe how lowering the relationship-strength slider increases scatter around the trend line and weakens the correlation indicator
Recognize that a correlation shows a tendency rather than a guarantee by locating outlier students who beat or missed expectations
